meaning:
λεπτός, -ή, -όν
(λέπω, to peel),
1. peeled.
2. fine, thin, small, light; hence, in late Gk., as subst. τὸ λ., a small coin (one-eighth of an as, AV, mite): Mrk.12:42, Luk.12:59 21:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
